claim: The cb-schema-v2 design (plans/cb-schema-v2/design.md, decided 2026-06-10) replaces the three-type schema with four structural types, one per epistemic operation: primitive (attest), compound (aggregate), inference (infer), directive (prescribe). The v1 implication type conflated two moods - descriptive conclusions licensed to exceed their deps, and prescriptions the house stands behind - and the machinery already sorted by that hidden boundary: materialization, the conflict audit, and contract grading attach only to prescriptions, while staleness and supersession-on-evidence respond to falsification of descriptions. Contract remains a structural grade, in v2 the machine-checkable grade of a directive.

evidence.detail: Design record written and stress-tested 2026-06-10 (worked sdl migration, per-collection inventory, code touch points); decisions D1-D6 resolved the same day, D1 (type name 'inference') confirmed by Mark for launch with the immutable-history consideration explicitly overridden in favor of long-term terminology. Preflight 2026-06-10: tag/claim-overlap matches only (dag-schema contract family, 14 contract-level / 24 schema); reviewed per b032 - overlap is necessary but not sufficient for contradiction: no semantic conflict with active structure, since this primitive attests the v2 design record and prescribes nothing; the genuine tension with b026's three-value type enum resolves through the staged b026/b027/b029/b031/b032/b038 supersessions this primitive feeds in plan-2, per the b467/b040 precedent.
